questions.q: An airport concept that moves passengers to parked planes in vehicles, as at Dulles, is the:
questions.n: People movers on wheels replace long piers.

questions.q: Created by EO 90 as the top policy and coordinating office on shelter, later replaced by DHSUD:
questions.n: The Housing and Urban Development Coordinating Council.

questions.q: Lynch's channels of movement, like streets, transit lines and canals, are:
questions.n: Paths are what people travel along.

questions.q: Subdivision layout depends mostly on:
questions.n: These shape lots, roads and drainage.

questions.q: The former sole regulator of housing and land development, absorbed by DHSUD under RA 11201, was:
questions.n: HLURB's regulatory role passed to DHSUD and HSAC.

questions.q: Separating traffic lanes at an intersection with islands is:
questions.n: Islands guide turning movements.

questions.q: Bentley's quality of sensory experiences a place offers is:
questions.n: Sight, sound, touch and smell.

questions.q: The relationship of people and dwellings to a given land area is:
questions.n: Expressed per hectare.

questions.q: Lynch's medium-to-large city sections with a recognizable character are:
questions.n: Districts are areas you mentally "enter."

questions.q: A city growing in rings and radials from one center is:
questions.n: Rings plus radial corridors.

questions.q: Which agency runs the national provident fund for housing (Pag-IBIG)?
questions.n: The Home Development Mutual Fund.

questions.q: Bentley's quality offering a choice of forms, uses and meanings is:
questions.n: Mixed uses create varied experiences.

questions.q: Which urban model describes self-sufficient "realms," each with its own core?
questions.n: Vance's realms model suits sprawling metros.

questions.q: A bus terminal loading layout where bays are angled in a zigzag is the:
questions.n: Sawtooth bays let buses pull out independently.

questions.q: Bentley's quality of spaces that can serve many purposes over time is:
questions.n: Robust buildings adapt.

questions.q: The Comprehensive Land Use Plan is prepared by a licensed:
questions.n: CLUPs are EnP work.

questions.q: Bentley's quality concerned with detail and whether a place looks right for its use is:
questions.n: Details should signal the choices available.

questions.q: An urban form of one continuous sheet with a main cluster and several sub-clusters is the:
questions.n: Concentrations articulate an otherwise even sheet.

questions.q: In Lynch's Image of the City, strategic spots like junctions and squares that you enter and travel to and from are:
questions.n: Nodes are foci of activity.

questions.q: The agency set up by EO 272 to run the Community Mortgage Program for low-income families is:
questions.n: Social Housing Finance Corporation.

questions.q: In urban ecology, a new population or use moving into an occupied area is:
questions.n: Invasion comes first; succession is the full replacement.

questions.q: Ordering land use, building sites and routes for economy, convenience and beauty is:
questions.n: Physical planning deals with the spatial arrangement.

questions.q: In Bentley's Responsive Environments, how easily people understand a place's layout is:
questions.n: Legible places can be read and remembered.

questions.q: A radial city with green wedges left between its growth corridors is the:
questions.n: Fingers of development with open space between.

questions.q: Which agency backs housing finance through credit insurance and mortgage guarantees?
questions.n: HGC guarantees housing loans and securities.

questions.q: The major government home-mortgage market institution, buying mortgages using SSS, GSIS and Pag-IBIG funds, is:
questions.n: National Home Mortgage Finance Corporation.

questions.q: Several nearly equal cities close to one another form a:
questions.n: No single dominant center.
